definitions.explanation: Having no restrictions, limits, or caps. Used for quantities, time, access, and rules. Common in business, technology, and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: データ{通信|つうしん}が{無制限|むせいげん}のプランにした。
examples.english: I switched to a plan with unlimited data.

examples.japanese: このバイキングは{時間|じかん}{無制限|むせいげん}で{食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}だ。
examples.english: This buffet is all-you-can-eat with no time limit.

examples.japanese: {権力|けんりょく}を{無制限|むせいげん}に{行使|こうし}することは{許|ゆる}されない。
examples.english: The unlimited exercise of power is not permitted.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a no-adjective ({無制限|むせいげん}の〜) or as a na-adjective ({無制限|むせいげん}な〜), and also as an adverb with に ({無制限|むせいげん}に). Very common in advertising and service descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時間|じかん}{無制限|むせいげん} (no time limit)
- {無制限|むせいげん}プラン (unlimited plan)
- {無制限|むせいげん}に{使|つか}える (can use without limits)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無限|むげん}: infinite — more abstract and philosophical
- {制限|せいげん}なし: no restrictions — a more casual equivalent
- {自由|じゆう}: free — implies permission rather than absence of limits
